title: Joey Porter Jr. felt "disrespected" and "underappreciated" by Steelers

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Joey Porter Jr. felt "disrespected" and "underappreciated" by Steelers
sources.description: Cornerback Joey Porter Jr. was at the movies, watching Brad Pitt's Heart of the Beast, on Wednesday night when he received news that the Steelers had traded him to the Cowboys.
